cookie_policy.hero.title: Cookie Policy
cookie_policy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how pyBIM uses cookies, local browser storage, and related technologies on pybim.com. We prioritize user privacy and minimize data storage: our website operates without third-party advertising trackers or cross-site profiling.
cookie_policy.iubenda.title: Iubenda Hosted Cookie Policy
cookie_policy.iubenda.desc: Our standard Cookie Policy is registered and hosted on the Iubenda platform. Under our current free account tier, full in-page text embedding via JavaScript widget is not supported. The official hosted document is accessible directly via the link below:
cookie_policy.sec1.title: 1. What are Cookies and Browser Local Storage?
cookie_policy.sec1.desc: Cookies and local browser storage (localStorage) are small data mechanisms stored on your device when you interact with a website. They allow the site to remember user-selected interface states (such as your chosen theme) and protect form interactions.
cookie_policy.sec2.title: 2. Browser Storage Technologies Used on pybim.com
cookie_policy.sec2.desc: Our website distinguishes between two categories of storage:
cookie_policy.sec2.item1.title: Strictly Necessary Storage (Always Active):
cookie_policy.sec2.item1.desc: Essential for interface operation, security, and remembering user configuration. These include:
cookie_policy.sec2.item1.bullet1: 'pybim_theme' (localStorage): Remembers your chosen display theme (dark, light, or system preference).
cookie_policy.sec2.item1.bullet2: 'cookie_consent' (localStorage): Stores your cookie preference selections so the banner does not reappear on each visit.
cookie_policy.sec2.item1.bullet3: Cloudflare Turnstile security tokens: Ephemeral cryptographic verification tokens generated by Cloudflare to protect form endpoints against automated bot submissions.
cookie_policy.sec2.item2.title: Optional Analytics Storage:
cookie_policy.sec2.item2.desc: Intended for aggregated, non-profiling traffic measurement. Status: Currently, pyBIM does not deploy active third-party analytics trackers (such as Google Analytics or Meta Pixel). The consent toggle in the preferences modal is provided so that if optional analytics are introduced in the future, they remain disabled until explicit user consent is given.
cookie_policy.sec3.title: 3. Third-Party Infrastructure and Services
cookie_policy.sec3.desc: Our public site interacts with the following technical service providers:
cookie_policy.sec3.item1: Cloudflare (Workers & Turnstile): Edge network infrastructure, DDoS protection, and privacy-preserving bot detection without advertising cookies.
cookie_policy.sec3.item2: Resend: Transactional email delivery used to send user contact requests and ROI lead notifications to pyBIM Support.
cookie_policy.sec3.item3: Iubenda: External hosting platform for privacy and cookie documentation.
cookie_policy.sec4.title: 4. Managing Your Preferences
cookie_policy.sec4.desc: You can review and adjust your storage preferences at any time:
cookie_policy.sec4.browser_info: You can also clear or block local storage through your browser settings. Please note that clearing local storage will reset your saved theme and consent selections.

cookie.modal.desc: Manage which storage technologies you allow. Strictly necessary technologies cannot be disabled as they are required for basic site security and navigation.
cookie.category.necessary.title: Strictly Necessary
cookie.category.necessary.desc: Essential for core navigation, security tokens, language preferences, and interface state.
cookie.category.analytics.title: Analytics & Performance
cookie.category.analytics.desc: Intended for aggregated traffic measurement. (Currently inactive: no external analytics trackers are deployed on the website).
